name: RECT
about: Established in 2012, RECT is a forerunner in delivering technology-based education. Recognized as one of the Top 50 private universities in India, RECT with exemplary infrastructure, strives to benchmark new milestones in modern education.

name: AICTE IDEA Lab
about: The IDEA Lab is a state-of-the-art facility dedicated to fostering creativity, enhancing problem-solving abilities, and cultivating an entrepreneurial mindset among students, researchers, and faculty—driving innovation, design excellence and entrepreneurial growth. Equipped with advanced tools for digital fabrication, electronics development and 3D printing

name: Ansys by Synopsys
about: Ansys provides the industry-standard engineering simulation software that powers our design, testing, and optimization phases. By utilizing its advanced Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) capabilities, we can virtually simulate complex structural mechanics, aerodynamic forces, and thermal behaviors.
